Nelle Peters (1884-1974) was a trailblazing female architect who left an indelible mark on Kansas City's architectural landscape. Overcoming the challenges of a male-dominated field, she established herself as one of the most prolific architects of her time. During her remarkable career, Peters designed over a thousand buildings, including apartments, hotels, schools, and commercial spaces, with many of them listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

Her signature style often incorporated elements of Georgian Revival, Tudor Revival, and Beaux-Arts, creating a unique fusion of architectural styles that has stood the test of time. Nelle Peters' buildings are celebrated for their elegant exteriors, intricate detailing, and functional layouts that prioritize comfort and livability. Explore Kansas City!
Kansas City straddes the border betwen Missouri and Kansas, split down alongside the Missouri River. This unit is in Westport, an eclectic neighborhood in Kansas City, Missouri, the city's oldest established community, originally founded in 1833. Originally a vital outfitting hub for pioneers embarking on the Santa Fe, Oregon, and California Trails, it now functions as a vibrant urban district renowned for its nightlife, dining, and historic boutiques.

Top Tourist Attractions:
Kelly's Westport Inn: Located at the corner of Pennsylvania and Westport Road, this is widely considered the oldest building still standing in Kansas City, operating today as a beloved historic Irish pub

Harris-Kearney House Museum: Built in 1855, this beautifully preserved landmark is the oldest two-story brick home in Kansas City and offers a deep dive into the lives of early pioneers

Shopping and Boutiques: The district is highly walkable and packed with independent shops like Monkey Wrench Clothing (offering pin-up and alternative fashion) and Mills Record Company for vinyl enthusiasts

Local Eats & Nightlife: Westport is legendary for its culinary and bar scene. Must-visit stops include Beer Kitchen (known for gourmet burgers and craft beer), Westport Café (French-inspired bistro), and the iconic Westport Flea Market for great food and eclectic vibes. Don't miss out on the Country Club Plaza for fine dining. The Country Club Plaza in Kansas City is a historic, Spanish-inspired district featuring over 15 blocks of dining. Top local and upscale spots include Gram & Dun for gastropub fare with a sprawling patio, The Capital Grille for dry-aged steaks, and Jack Stack Barbecue for iconic Kansas City burnt ends

Yearly attractions in the area include the St Patrick's Day Parade in March, the Summer Beer festival in June, and the  Art Westport festival in September. There is a monthly first Friday art walk downtown, parades, music and theatre shows.
